key.name: use-device-limits
key.summary: Take the slider range from the device
key.description: Read MinTdp/MaxTdp from PowerStation, which sources them from its APU and DMI override databases. Per-device caps belong there, not here. Not every platform reports a range; the bounds below cover those.

key.name: min-tdp
key.summary: Lower bound of the slider when the device reports none, in watts

key.name: max-tdp
key.summary: Upper bound of the slider when the device reports none, in watts

key.name: boost-watts
key.summary: Headroom above the sustained limit when boost is on, in watts
key.description: PowerStation sets the slow PPT to TDP + this and the fast PPT to 1.25x that. The default mirrors hhd, whose boost raised the slow limit by 2 W.

key.name: step
key.summary: Granularity of the slider, in watts
